crossRefs.note: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise…
He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious…
For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession…
However Yahweh, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he…
Of all my sons (for Yahweh has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of Yahweh’s…
‘I have made the earth, the men, and the animals that are on the surface of the earth by my great power and by my…
even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no…

even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness…
Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,”…

Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies:
A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

translations.web: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
translations.bsb: Do I not have the right to do as I please with what is mine? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
translations.kjv: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
translations.asv: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? or is thine eye evil, because I am good?
